Three messages observe the body and the references without paying for the rest of the page generation (the #1815 trials ran about 10 turns, 0.215 USD). The probe runs with probeMaxTurns.

toolsNote: Only the stage-1 level W (Read, Write, Edit, Glob, Grep, Skill; --permission-mode acceptEdits; no Bash), with the same --settings file as stage 1 (run-trial.mjs isolationSettings), the setting under which the stage-1 W probe passed.
settingsNote: Every level gets the same --settings file (run-trial.mjs isolationSettings): permissions.blockReadsOutsideWorkingDirectories, and a sandbox for Bash (enabled, failIfUnavailable, no unsandboxed escape, auto-allow of sandboxed commands, no network domain, denyRead of /Users, the runs root, the fixture and the ledger directory with the trial's work/ re-allowed, denyWrite of the fixture and the ledger directory). Only X has Bash, so the sandbox acts only there; the same file in all levels keeps the levels apart only by their tools and permission mode.

budget.note: Owner cap 25 USD for stages 1 and 2 together (Issue #1820 owner decision 2026-11-26). Stage 1 spent 2.0281387 USD (its published ledger ../results/ledger.jsonl, sha256 pinned here; run-trial.mjs recomputes the total from that file and refuses when it differs). The stage-2 cap is the remainder rounded down to the cent, 22.97 USD; run-trial.mjs refuses a trial when the stage-2 ledger total + this trial's budget exceeds capUsd - safetyMarginUsd = 21.97 USD, so both stages together stay at or below 2.03 + 21.97 = 24.0 USD. perTrialUsd is the --max-budget-usd of every trial and its ledger reservation, the same as #1817 (0.6 USD; #1817 measured 0.085 mean and 0.141 max per full read-only trial). probeUsd: the stage-1 W probe cost 0.121 USD.
